reference.notes:
I filled in the four functions in `packages/core/src/ticket.ts`, and all the tests pass. No other file was changed.

- **`normalizeSpecText`** is the same code as the private `normalize` in `packages/jira/src/spec.ts`. It splits lines on `\r\n`, `\r` or `\n`, trims the end of each line, joins them with `\n`, then trims both ends of the result.
- **`ticketSpecHash`** works the same way as Jira's `pricingSpecHash`, so hashes already stored stay valid. It takes a SHA-256 of the JSON array of the three normalized strings, using `crypto.subtle` rather than `node:crypto`, and returns lowercase hex.
- **`clampTicketTitle`** returns a title of 255 characters or fewer unchanged. A longer title is cut to its first 255. If that cut would split an emoji in half, the leftover half is dropped too. Nothing is trimmed and no ellipsis is added.
- **`ticketKey`** returns `jiraKey` exactly as given whenever it is a string, even an empty or blank one. Otherwise it returns `T-` followed by the number.

- `ticket-content-confirmed.*`: 51 of 51 pass.
